frontmatter_snapshot.summary: CART is a non-parametric supervised learning algorithm that partitions the feature space by recursive binary splits at decision nodes; terminal nodes predict the majority class for classification problems or the terminal-node mean for regression problems. CART is not in CFA L1 2022 Quantitative Methods; the parametric counterpart in R7 is simple linear regression.
